findings.title: A failed bless can bypass the version-only guard on retry
findings.claim: The unified bless writes both goldens before validating the determinism fixture, and it decides whether to run the per-tick guard from basic.json alone.
findings.why: If fixture validation rejects the first run, basic.json is already at SIM 37. A retry treats it as a same-version bless and skips the per-tick comparison, allowing a later sector gameplay change to be blessed.
findings.fix: Validate and stage all three artifacts before writing any of them. Check the stored versions of every pinned artifact, and require the per-tick guard while any artifact is being moved from 36 to 37.

findings.title: The log cleanup can discard concurrent edits
findings.claim: The unconditional checkout restores an entire tracked log directory after the determinism run.
findings.why: Any uncommitted edit another session makes in that directory before the checkout is lost. The directory is currently clean, but the plan is meant to run in a shared checkout.
findings.fix: Run `npm run test:determinism -- --output-dir=out/r0-determinism` and remove the checkout step.
